title: Fluency (Theme 1: School)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child points under each word, reads every letter left to right, and sounds out a new word instead of guessing.
steps: Read the text to the child.

board.do: Write: The goat is in the garden.

board.say: Read with me, then on your own.

board.do: The child underlines the word that was hard.

listen_for: The goat is in the grass.
misconceptions.ask: Look at all the letters: does it say grass?
Which way does the belly face?
Did your finger touch every word?
Is that word on the page?

checks.question: Read: The dog dug a big hole.
checks.answer: dog, dug and big read right

checks.question: Read: We go to the market on Saturday.
